In the middle of my 7th grade year we went to trial and I faced the man and I was shaking. He told me that it was my fault and that I shouldn’t have told my parents. Because then we wouldn’t be where we were. He was sentenced to 10 years in prison.

Senior year I moved out after my 18th birthday. I moved in with a family friend and alternated living there and at my boyfriend’s at the time. Life was okay, I didn’t have any intrusive thoughts. I graduated high school and my boyfriend’s parents offered that I visit my nana

I felt alone, and like nobody wanted me around. I turned to the church and thought that if I was saved I wouldn’t feel as empty inside. I was wrong. I began to self harm again, wear long sleeves in the humid Mississippi heat so nobody would notice my cuts.

In October, my close friend told me that my boyfriend was cheating on me. I didn’t believe her, eventually the girl he cheated on me with contacted me and told me herself. I was mad at her. To the point where hearing her name made me want to puke.

I thought about moving back in December to surprise (said name). He gave me a promise ring, and took notice to my scars. He said that I should be happy and not mutilate myself. A month later things got bad with my mental health and I broke up with him.

He had no idea that I was planning to kill myself when my roommate left. I didn’t answer his phone calls. I had a hand full of pills in my hand, I was crying so hard that I was dry heaving. He called again and talked me out of it- even though we weren’t together

May of 2017, I moved out again. I moved in with the same family friend that helped me before, and then a classmate in August. I started a job that I loved, matured a little bit, but still felt like nobody wanted around. I called my dad and said I wanted to go to school.
